title: Spring 2026 Examination Notice & Timetable Release
summary: Final comprehensive examination schedule and hall ticket download instructions for all undergraduate and postgraduate degrees.
content: All candidates appearing for the forthcoming End-Semester Spring Examinations are instructed to download their authorized hall tickets from the student portal before August 10th. Strict identity verification via biometric or student RFID badge is mandatory at the examination center entrance. No electronic gadgets or programmable calculators are permitted inside examination halls.
author: Dr. R. K. Saxena (CoE)

title: Campus Placement Drive 2026: Tier-1 Tech Recruiters
summary: Registration open for Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and Tata Consultancy campus recruitment drives for eligible 6th & 8th semester students.
content: Eligible candidates with an overall CGPA >= 7.5 and no active backlogs must upload their updated single-page resume and GitHub portfolios to the T&P portal by August 14, 5:00 PM. Technical screening coding rounds will take place on HackerRank across August 18-20.
author: Prof. S. N. Mehra (Head, T&P)

title: Mandatory Biometric & RFID Attendance System Upgrade
summary: New contactless attendance readers installed across all 40 smart lecture halls and laboratories starting next Monday.
content: Students are reminded that the minimum statutory requirement of 75% attendance in each registered subject remains strictly enforced to qualify for end-semester examinations. Check your real-time attendance percentages weekly on the portal dashboard.
author: Dr. Manisha Roy (Dean Academics)

title: Independence Day Holiday & Flag Hoisting Ceremony
summary: University campus will remain closed on August 15th for regular lectures; formal ceremonial flag hoisting at 8:30 AM.
content: All faculty, staff, and students are cordially invited to participate in the 80th Independence Day flag hoisting ceremony at the University Central Flag Quadrangle at 8:30 AM sharp. Refreshments will be served following the national anthem.
author: Col. V. P. Nair (Registrar)

title: Library Extended Hours & Digital Database Access
summary: Central Library will remain open 24x7 throughout the examination preparation period with remote IEEE & Springer access.
content: To support students during exam preparation, the reading rooms, quiet study pods, and digital research terminals will operate round the clock. Students can log in to remote proxy for access to IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, and ACM Digital Library.
author: Chief Librarian Mr. O. P. Gupta

title: Merit & Means-Based Scholarship Applications Open
summary: Annual state and institutional scholarship disbursement applications open for academic excellence and economic assistance.
content: Eligible candidates can apply for institutional tuition fee waivers and government merit scholarships. Completed application forms along with parent income certificates and latest semester transcripts must be verified at the Student Welfare Desk by September 10th.
author: Dean of Student Welfare

title: Inter-Departmental Sports Meet Trials Schedule
summary: Selection trials for University cricket, basketball, volleyball, and badminton teams scheduled across this weekend.
content: Students aspiring to represent the university in AIU tournaments must attend physical trials with proper sporting attire and kit at the main stadium on September 6th and 7th starting from 7:00 AM.
author: Sports Director Mr. Rajesh Rawat

title: Hostel Maintenance & Wi-Fi Bandwidth Upgrade
summary: Wi-Fi access points upgraded to Wi-Fi 6 across Boys and Girls Hostel Blocks A, B, and C with 1 Gbps fiber backbone.
content: The university IT cell has deployed 120 new dual-band Wi-Fi 6 access points in all residential blocks. A scheduled maintenance downtime of 2 hours will occur on September 12 between 2:00 AM and 4:00 AM.
author: Network Administrator
